title.narrative: Capacity Building of Institute of Capital Markets (ICM)

description.narrative: The main purpose of the IDF (the grant) is to develop the capacity of the Institute of Capital Markets (ICM) to enable the Institute to promote knowledge and develop professional standards in the financial markets of Pakistan. Main objectives include: enabling ICM to improve public awareness of its program; strengthening the institute's program offerings through quality assurance and help in development of new programs and curriculum; developing a resource center including library and database for the stakeholders; and developing a forum for business policy roundtables and consultations. The recipient of this grant is the Government of Pakistan and the implementing agency is the Karachi-based Institute of Capital Markets (ICM). The main purpose of the grant is to develop the capacity of ICM to enable it to promote knowledge and to introduce professional standards in Pakistan’s financial sector and markets. The main objectives include: enabling ICM to improve public awareness of its program through conferences; strengthening the institute’s program offerings through quality assurance and development of new programs and curriculum; and establishment of a resource center including a library and database within ICM.
